title: At 57 columns the High Table cannot keep 22 px spacing, +N one step on, and 18 px divider clearance
context: At bodyColumns 57 the High Table section runs x 194 to 320.1; its content box is x0 212 to inner 302.1 (18 px clear of the divider), 90.1 px. AC-14 and FR-11 ask for seats 22 px apart and +N centred one full step (22 px) after the third seat, then the hairline and CA as today; NFR-3 and hud.md ask for 18 px either side of the divider. The tightest packing needs about 92 px: first seat ring from x0+1, three seats and +N over 66 px, then +N half-width 5, a 3 px gap, the hairline, 3 px, the chief ring r 5 and the CA label half-width 6. That is more than 90.1, so the three cannot all hold. Today's commit 6c242ecd keeps 22 px and +N one step on by running the chief to the section edge: the ring ends at 319.8 and CA at about 320, against the divider at 319.6. At 93 columns everything fits with room to spare.
